description: Surfaces the punch-researcher subagent's FINAL message to the user on SubagentStop. Reads last_assistant_message (provided directly in the SubagentStop input) and emits it as a systemMessage, which renders as a visible hook block. systemMessage only -- never additionalContext or decision fields. PURE POWERSHELL host command -- no python, no sh: Cowork Chat runs hooks on the Windows host, which has PowerShell but not python. Matcher is scoped to this plugin's subagent; broaden to "*" to echo every subagent's final message. Disable with EPLUS_NO_SUBAGENT_ECHO=1.
